sloka: मया तु सर्वं यत्सत्यं तस्मै सर्वं निवेदितम् ।काममोहाभिभूतात्मा नाश्रौषीत्तद्वचो मम ।। ७.२६.५० ॥
transliteration: mayā tu sarvaṁ yatsatyaṁ tasmai sarvaṁ niveditam ।kāmamohābhibhūtātmā nāśrauṣīttadvaco mama ।। 7.26.50 ॥

translations.english: But I reported everything truly to him, yet his mind, overcome by lust and delusion, did not listen to my words.
